inclusions.source: A seven-night Nile cruise — south from Luxor past Edfu and Kom Ombo to Aswan and Abu Simbel and back — gives you the monuments and the water simultaneously.

inclusions.text: Private cabin aboard a comfortable shared five-star vessel
inclusions.source: Your party travels privately throughout: your own licensed English-speaking Egyptologist on every guided excursion, private air-conditioned transfers everywhere ashore, and a private cabin aboard a comfortable shared five-star vessel.
